name: openmedkit-electron-harness
description: Local packaged-app qualification harness for the OpenMedKit Electron integration.
author: OpenMed

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run stage && npm run install-electron && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.test:unpackaged: npm run typecheck && npm run stage && npm run install-electron && OPENMED_ELECTRON_HARNESS_MODE=unpackaged node --test ../../../tests/web/test_electron_packaged_harness.mjs
